items.headline: Why Trump Made a Diesel Deal With Putin
items.teaser: Our national security and White House correspondent David E. Sanger breaks down why President Donald Trump struck a deal with President V…
items.story:
Our national security and White House correspondent David E. Sanger breaks down why President Donald Trump struck a deal with President Vladimir V. Putin to import Russian diesel fuel in the coming months, despite having signed recent congressional legislation tightening energy sanctions on Russia.

A bipartisan group of 12 senators called on the president to drop his decision to ease sanctions on Russia’s exports of diesel fuel, saying the deal would help Moscow continue the war in Ukraine.

Shocked by the U.S. agreement with Russia, which Ukraine has called “a gift” to President Putin, officials in Europe have coalesced around a cautious diplomatic message.

President Trump is moving to buy Russian diesel while also pressuring Ukraine to halt attacks on refineries, a lifeblood of Moscow’s war machine.

Reporting by NY Times World. Read the full story at the original publication.

items.story: Rep. Suzan DelBene (D-WA), DCCC Chair, says Republicans are in “triage mode” and moving resources to defend seats they already hold. Rep. DelBene says Democrats are making spending decisions based on race-level data and conditions on the ground as the House map expands. Rep. DelBene says the DCCC is prioritizing frontliners, incumbents and races where it has already invested before adding support to newly competitive contests as more resources come in. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Lein

items.story: ഭര്‍ത്താവിനെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയ ഭാര്യയ്ക്ക് നേരെ മുട്ടയെറിഞ്ഞ് നാട്ടുകാരുടെ രോഷപ്രകടനം Asianet News Malayalamരാജു കൊലക്കേസ്: പ്രതിയായ ഭാര്യ ലേഖ മേരിയെ ചീമുട്ടയെറിഞ്ഞ് നാട്ടുകാർ Manorama Onlineഭര്‍ത്താവിനെ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തിയ ഭാര്യക്കുനേരെ മുട്ടയെറിഞ്ഞ് നാട്ടുകാരുടെ രോഷ പ്രകടനം Siraj Dailyവെള്ളിമൺ കൊലപാതകം: ലേഖാമേരിയെ വീട്ടിലെത്തിച്ച് തെളിവെടുത്തു Mathrubhumiഭർത്താവിനെ ബെൽറ്റ് മുറുക്കി കൊന്നകേസ് ; തെളിവെടുപ്പിനിടെ പ്രതി ലേഖയെ ചീമുട്ടയെറിഞ്ഞ് നാട്ടുകാർ News18 Malayalam
